inputs.text: [excited] PROH… toh… SEH… rah… tops. [curious] "Proto," in Greek, means the first. "Cerat" is horn. And "ops" is face.

[happily] Almost: he didn't [curious] have a real horn yet, just a small bump on his nose. [warmly] The very first ancestor of the horned dinos. He lived in Mongolia, in Asia, seventy-five million years ago.
[curious] Who did he live with, out there?
[serious] Velociraptor hunted in that same desert.
